def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # anchor color: color of the multi-cell shape (most common non-key?)
    # find key: vertical strip of single cells each row exactly? find cells forming key = cells whose color appears in a vertical run of single cells
    # simpler: anchor color = color with most cells forming the shape; key cells = other colors
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v!=0)
    anchor=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # key cells: cells not anchor, not 0
    keycells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (0,anchor)]
    keycells.sort()  # top to bottom
    seq=[c for _,_,c in keycells]
    k=seq.index(anchor)

    # anchor cells
    ac=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==anchor]
    i0=min(i for i,j in ac); i1=max(i for i,j in ac)
    j0=min(j for i,j in ac); j1=max(j for i,j in ac)
    rel=[(i-i0,j-j0) for i,j in ac]
    hh=i1-i0+1
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def paint(col, top):
        for di,dj in rel:

            if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=col
    top=i0
    for col in reversed(above):
        top-=hh; paint(col, top)
    paint(anchor, i0)
    top=i0+hh
    for col in below:
        paint(col, top); top+=hh
    return out
